title: OKP Capacity Offer (proposal)
description: What a site can produce inside one time window, given its current state. A perishable answer, not a listing. PROPOSAL 0.1-draft. This is not part of OKP v0.2, it is not ratified, and it is not stable to build against.

item_id.description: An item_id the site's capability document declares.

window.description: The fulfilment window the units are producible in. Not a delivery estimate: a window the site is prepared to be held to.

available_units.description: Units producible in the window on top of load already committed. Zero is a legitimate and useful answer. Capacity is expressed in units; staffing, roster and headcount never appear here.

basis.description: How the number was arrived at: read from the running system, produced by a model of it, or asserted by the operator.

confidence.description: The field exists to carry uncertainty, not to hide it.

expires_at.description: After this instant the offer is void and MUST NOT be held against. An offer without an expiry is a promise with no owner.

price.description: Informational only. This proposal defines no payment instrument, authorisation, settlement, refund or tax semantics; a payment protocol owns all of that.

amount.description: Price per unit, exclusive of anything this proposal does not define.

order_by.description: Latest instant a commitment against this offer can be confirmed. Usually earlier than the window, because production has to start.

ext.description: Vendor extensions. Keys MUST be reverse-domain names controlled by the producer.
